limits: Dedicated testnet agent only; chain 4c78adac; no mainnet, physical programming or production credentials.
All machine writes serialized by the global network lock; released after final successful run.
No indefinite renewal/alerts guarantee; finite targets, owner-run executor, bounded gas and optional configured notifier.

Live certification/readback and renewal were real Walrus testnet operations. Actual expired-byte restoration is exercised by the real-daemon simulator with verified retained bytes and authorized new reference; no claim that a testnet blob was kept until expiry.
Final manual extension-wallet, production Seal/provider, mainnet and physical checks remain #32/#159.
Runner head fields identify startup commits; workspace changes were under validation. Exact final-head CI is independently required and linked in the PR/issue.
